subject.title: Add the Turkish landing page (/tr/) for SEO
subject.author: francordel
subject.body:
## Context

Turkish was added to the app in #18, but there is no static landing page at `https://kdemos.com/tr/`, so search engines have nothing to index in Turkish and the language switchers on the other landings do not list it. You need to speak Turkish to take this one.

## Where

- `scripts/generate-i18n-landings.mjs`: the `LANGS` object has one entry per landing (`en`, `de`, ..., `no`). Copy one (e.g. `de`) and translate it.
- `public/sitemap.xml`: add `https://kdemos.com/tr/`.

## What to do

1. Add a `tr` entry to `LANGS` with all the same fields (title, desc, h1, sub, cta, how, faq, ...). Keep it natural, not word for word.
2. Run `node scripts/generate-i18n-landings.mjs`. It regenerates every `public/<code>/index.html`, so the new hreflang and language switcher reach all landings. Commit all generated files.
3. Add the URL to `public/sitemap.xml` with its `xhtml:link` alternates, like the other languages.

## Acceptance criteria

- `public/tr/index.html` exists, has `lang="tr"`, a Turkish title and description, and links to the app with `?lang=tr`.
- Every other landing lists "Türkçe" in its language switcher and has `hreflang="tr"`.
---
Setup: `npm install && REACT_APP_DB_MODE=mock npm start` (no credentials needed). Run tests with `CI=true npm test -- --watchAll=false`.
Conventions: [.github/CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/francordel/kdemos/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md). Comment here if you want to take it, and ask anything you are unsure about.
